## Findings ledger
- [D3.DOC1.F5] Capitalist economic myths are distinguished from traditional religious myths by their historical transience — dim: scope_and_force — position: capitalist myths guide action but do not claim permanent validity — force: comparative and temporally bounded — conditions: capitalist myths undergo generation, diffusion, institutionalization and decline, unlike religious myths that generally claim timeless validity — anchor: "In contrast to religious myths, which – as a rule – claim timeless validity, their development is characterized by a cyclical process of generation-diffusion-institutionalization and decline" — doc: promise — confidence: high — trimmed-anchor: yes

scope_outcomes.criterion: A scoped formulation must qualify a proposition by quantifier, modality, time, domain or condition, or alter its argumentative force through local wording.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected text contains explicit qualifications including 'only', 'necessarily', conditional formulations, temporal phase restrictions, comparative contrasts and interrogative uncertainty.
limitations: The assessment concerns scope and force of wording, not the truth of the article's substantive claims.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
